candidate_ideas.statement: On Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) for smooth genus-6 degree-four covers with balanced splitting F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), the reduced evaluation-failure locus Z_red equals the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence locus defined by O_C(p_1+...+p_6) isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.
For every geometric ordered pairwise-distinct degree-six divisor Gamma, evaluation fails if and only if O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.
The quotient of Z_red by S_6 is the reduced-support open in the relative effective-divisor incidence space for L, and Z_red to Z_red/S_6 is a finite etale S_6-torsor.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover with balanced splitting F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), the f=4 component of the CE evaluation obstruction bundle omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma) has degree -4 for any degree-six divisor Gamma, so H^0 of that component vanishes identically.

On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover with balanced splitting F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), the f=5 component of the CE evaluation obstruction bundle has degree 0 for any degree-six divisor Gamma, and evaluation fails on Gamma if and only if O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus.
Agreement of the evaluation-failure locus and the Abel–Jacobi incidence locus on geometric points implies equality of their reduced induced substacks.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 degree/Serre-duality calculation in packet C66-001-v3
established_facts.statement: Under the Casnati–Ekedahl convention W_{f_i}=O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f_i)|_C, the degree formula deg(W_{f_i}|_C)=4g+12-4f_i holds.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v3 canonical geometric bottleneck CE line-bundle convention
established_facts.statement: For g=6 and the balanced splitting F=O_{P^1}(4) direct-sum O_{P^1}(5), the f_2=5 summand is W_5:=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C; it is not the O_{P^1}(5) summand of F.
For g=6, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1})=6.
On each smooth connected genus-6 fibre, for L=W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} one has chi(L)=1 and therefore h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)>=1.
For any degree-six divisor Gamma on a smooth genus-6 fibre, deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=-4, hence H^0(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=0 and the f=4 obstruction component vanishes identically.
For any degree-six divisor Gamma on a smooth genus-6 fibre, deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma))=0.

established_facts.evidence: Degree-zero line-bundle lemma used in the observable obstruction comparison for the f=5 summand
established_facts.statement: A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve admits a nonzero global section if and only if it is isomorphic to O_C.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v3 canonical geometric bottleneck: six-point failure locus and SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 f_2=5 summand with sign gamma^*O(-5)
established_facts.statement: The packet six-point failure criterion equates geometric evaluation failure with the isomorphism O_C(Gamma) isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v3 canonical geometric bottleneck ordering model
established_facts.statement: The model for ordered distinct reduced divisors is a finite etale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in the relative linear system; that reduced-support locus is open, not closed.
For d=3g-3+n, the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), identified by Poincare duality with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d).
For the RED-0001 residual list over Q, the required ordinary degree 2d-16 equals vcd for (3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,2) and equals vcd-1 for (8,0),(8,1); it never exceeds vcd.

For the forgetful map M_{6,6} to M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(M_{6,5})=25; with fibre cohomology only in degrees q=0,1, no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v3 exact target and exact theorem statements
established_facts.statement: The exact target group is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6}), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6})(21); the stated theorem asserts this group is a direct sum of Q(8).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Geometric-point agreement determines only the underlying reduced support; nilpotent structure and Fitting ideals of a determinantal rank-drop locus need not match the ideal of the Abel–Jacobi fibre product, especially where the f=5 obstruction dimension jumps.
invalid_steps.statement: Conclude that the full determinantal/Fitting evaluation-failure scheme Z equals the Abel–Jacobi incidence scheme I as nonreduced schemes solely from agreement on geometric points.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The sheaf pi_*L has fibrewise rank equal to h^0(L), which may jump; only the reduced-support open of the relative effective-divisor incidence space is modeled by the linear system of L, not a global Proj construction.
invalid_steps.statement: Identify the entire relative incidence space with Proj of pi_*L.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: On coarse spaces the S_6-action need not be free: curves with nontrivial automorphisms produce nontrivial stabilizers, so the ordering map ramifies and is not an etale S_6-torsor.
invalid_steps.statement: Formulate the S_6 ordering comparison as a finite etale torsor on coarse moduli spaces rather than on stacks with pairwise-distinct sections.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The locus of reduced-support effective divisors is open in the relative effective-divisor space; treating it as closed misstates its scheme-theoretic position and its finite etale S_6-cover model.
invalid_steps.statement: Call the reduced-support locus in the relative effective-divisor space a closed locus.
